## Declarations and implementations

```plato

//==
// # Optimization solver parameters
//
// The tuning records of the standard iterative solvers, gradient-based and
// derivative-free. Each is a pure parameter record; the seeded population
// methods are deterministic given their Seed. The goals, stopping rules, and
// results these solvers share live in the first section above.

//==
// # Gradient-based solver parameters

// Tuning of gradient descent. LearningRate scales each step, Momentum in
// [0, 1) blends in the previous step, and Decay multiplies the learning rate
// after every iteration (1 keeps it constant).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gradient_descent)
type GradientDescentParameters
    implements IValue
{
    LearningRate: Number;
    Momentum: Number;
    Decay: Number;
}

// Tuning of the limited-memory BFGS quasi-Newton method. MemorySize is the
// number of past step/gradient pairs retained.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Limited-memory_BFGS)
type LbfgsParameters
    implements IValue
{
    MemorySize: Integer;
    LineSearch: LineSearch;
}

//==
// # Derivative-free solver parameters

// The reflection, expansion, contraction, and shrink coefficients of the
// Nelder-Mead simplex method (standard values 1, 2, 0.5, 0.5).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nelder%E2%80%93Mead_method)
type NelderMeadParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Reflection: Number;
    Expansion: Number;
    Contraction: Number;
    Shrink: Number;
}

// Tuning of simulated annealing. Temperature starts at InitialTemperature
// and is multiplied by CoolingRate (in (0, 1)) each iteration; Seed fixes
// the random sequence.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simulated_annealing)
type SimulatedAnnealingParameters
    implements IValue
{
    InitialTemperature: Number;
    CoolingRate: Number;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Tuning of a genetic algorithm: population size, per-gene mutation and
// per-pair crossover probabilities, the count of elite individuals copied
// unchanged each generation, and the random seed.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genetic_algorithm)
type GeneticAlgorithmParameters
    implements IValue
{
    PopulationSize: Integer;
    MutationProbability: Probability;
    CrossoverProbability: Probability;
    EliteCount: Integer;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Tuning of differential evolution: population size, the differential
// weight F scaling donor differences, the crossover probability, and the
// random seed.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Differential_evolution)
type DifferentialEvolutionParameters
    implements IValue
{
    PopulationSize: Integer;
    DifferentialWeight: Number;
    CrossoverProbability: Probability;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Tuning of particle-swarm optimization: swarm size, the inertia retained
// from each particle's velocity, the pulls toward the particle's own best
// (cognitive) and the swarm's best (social), and the random seed.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Particle_swarm_optimization)
type ParticleSwarmParameters
    implements IValue
{
    SwarmSize: Integer;
    Inertia: Number;
    CognitiveWeight: Number;
    SocialWeight: Number;
    Seed: Integer;
}
```
